rule: a site lists every parcel one of its contacts lies in; a contact with no measured label is in no parcel

methods.native: the patient's own FreeSurfer reconstruction, read by iELVis (per contact)
methods.synthetic: synthetic demonstration data: the template stands in for the person's own brain

validation.rule: native labels only for DK, Destrieux, Yeo-7 and deep structures; surface contacts drawn at their registered fsaverage vertex; people with a documented localisation question held
